orders.summary: The appellant disputes a supplementary bill of Rs. 11,65,000 raised for alleged slow running of the meter between March 2022 and August 2023. Issue notice.
directions: Disconnection is stayed subject to deposit of 30 per cent of the bill.

orders.summary: Reply is filed with the meter testing report. The appellant says it was not present when the meter was tested. Both sides state that the matter may be settled if the billing period is restricted to six months.
Parties report that a revised bill of Rs. 4,10,000 has been proposed and is awaiting approval of the respondent's competent authority. Time is sought jointly.
